item.title: Border Raids and Moving Targets: How Scam Networks Thrive in the Golden Triangle
item.description: “When there are raids in Tachileik, they cross over to the Lao side. When there are raids in Laos, they come back here.” Nang Tip*, 23, describes the pattern with the calm certainty of someone who has watched it repeat for years. A resident of Tachileik — the border town where Myanmar, Thailand, and Laos […] The post Border Raids and Moving Targets: How Scam Networks Thrive in the Golden Triangle appeared first on Shan Herald Agency for News.
